changelog: Servers reached across an ICMP or PCK link now show PCK or ICMP under Servers instead of plain UDP. A server that joined over a link no longer claims to be the main server under Peers & invite; it points to the server it joined through. The advice to turn off mesh encryption on ICMP/PCK meshes is corrected: joined servers also talk to each other directly over plain UDP, so keep encryption on unless the mesh has just two servers.
